authoritative_success_condition: PASS only if Q0-Q11 all pass. Any failure preserves the protocol and requires an explicit versioned correction before 58-candidate admission. No gate may be weakened after observing fixture results.

allowed: six frozen canonical seed source files
deterministically generated qualification fixtures defined below

fixture_families.expected: All three anchors TRANSPORT_PRESENT_EXACT and ROLE_COMPATIBLE; both guard binding slots available.
fixture_families.recipe: Candidate bytes equal canonical seed bytes.

fixture_families.expected: Executable anchor remains uniquely PRESENT; decoy is ignored.

fixture_families.expected: Anchors remain uniquely PRESENT; raw identifier spelling is not required.
fixture_families.recipe: Deterministically rename identifiers while preserving grammar and executable structure.

fixture_families.expected: TRANSPORT_PRESENT_EDIT_DESCENDANT; ROLE_COMPATIBLE; exact-slice witness need not survive.
fixture_families.recipe: Change one internal executable token inside an anchor while preserving its surrounding lexical boundaries and broad syntax kind.

fixture_families.expected: Lineage PRESENT_EDIT_DESCENDANT; realization ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE; guard binding slots unavailable.
fixture_families.recipe: Replace a comparison anchor body with a parse-valid non-comparison expression while preserving unique surrounding boundaries.

fixture_families.recipe: Delete one anchored executable region while preserving unique left/right executable context and valid containing syntax.

fixture_policy.fixture_source: Qualification transformations are generic source-lineage stressors, not E2 mutation operators and carry no expected A3/A4 verdict.
fixture_policy.required_language_family_matrix: Every family must have one deterministic microfixture per required language (36 language-family cases total). In addition, BASELINE_IDENTITY must run on all six canonical seeds and all three frozen anchors.

authorized: construct a sanitized opaque 58-case admission manifest using only seed_id, language, candidate source bytes/hash, and derived transport_case_id
freeze that admission manifest before transport outputs
not_authorized: read mutation truth/operator metadata/expected E2 predictions in the transport engine

purpose: Falsify the frozen transport algorithm on mutation-free generic transport mechanics before any of the 58 candidate revisions are opened.

qualification_gates.Q0_CLOSED_READ_SET: No forbidden source opened or parsed by generator, engine, checker, or workflow.
qualification_gates.Q10_DETERMINISM: Two engine replays and two independent-checker replays are byte-identical.
qualification_gates.Q11_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: No transport result contains consequence regression/stability/safety verdict and no 58-candidate or fresh-target claim is emitted.
qualification_gates.Q1_PROTOCOL_IDENTITY: Transport protocol and receipt schema Git blobs equal the pre-execution frozen authorities.
qualification_gates.Q2_CANONICAL_SEED_IDENTITY: All six unchanged canonical seeds satisfy F01 on all 18 anchors and 12 binding slots.
qualification_gates.Q3_GENERIC_FIXTURE_MATRIX: All 36 language-family microfixtures produce exactly the frozen expected lineage/realization class.
qualification_gates.Q4_NO_CONTROL_RELATION_AS_TRANSPORT_FEAT: Source audit verifies relative anchor order, branch polarity, dominance, effect-before-guard relation, and downstream overlay verdict are absent from transport acceptance logic.
qualification_gates.Q5_NO_FORBIDDEN_TEXT_FEATURES: Source audit and specialization scan show no mutation operator names/classes, expected labels, target/repository names, or comments/docstrings used as transport semantics.
qualification_gates.Q6_AMBIGUITY_FAILS_CLOSED: F10 and F11 cannot be converted to PRESENT by tie-break, score, source line proximity, lexical name, or arbitrary iteration order.
qualification_gates.Q7_ABSENCE_IS_STRICT: F06 requires the frozen dual deletion proof and cannot be triggered merely by missing exact text.
qualification_gates.Q8_REALIZATION_SEPARATION: F05 proves source lineage can be PRESENT while syntax realization is ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE and binding slots are unavailable.
qualification_gates.Q9_CONTENT_ADDRESSING: Independent checker recomputes witness evidence hashes, receipt digest, candidate source hash, and all spans/endpoints.
